entry.title: TAPESCAM 0.5.5
entry.summary: Tape saturation and degradation: drive, tape speed, dropout noise and tone. Port of the Schwung module **TAPESCAM** by charlesvestal to the MPC/Force plugin host, compiled unchanged from `charlesvestal/schwung-tapescam` at `e9ab1ae20aa7` (`MIT`), linked with the mpc-vst-plugins VST2 wrapper and this repository's Schwung adapter `adapters/schwungfx/`. Gen1 build: armv7, glibc ≤ 2.29. ## Sources - module: https://github.com/charlesvestal/schwung-tapescam/tree/e9ab1ae20aa780da23a9a284d7e95402f51d17
